> Yes, but that is `TEXT`. I doubt that text is mapped to `VARCHAR(255)` in Postgres.

Currently, title is defined as VARCHAR(255) and note as TEXT. The title represents the first line of the commit message, while note contains the rest. However, both fields may be too short to store the full content.

Could you please paste the entire commit message here so we can verify?

No idea what you need to "verify" since it is clearly a bug that the splitted message exceeds the release.Title

> This was the last one. Let me know if I should dig up more

Thank you for the feedback! But this message isn't the one that causes the bug ... 😄 

The "releases" are inserted in batch, so any one of the tags that has long message will cause the error.

Although I think there is no need to check the tag messages one by one ..... if you'd like to dig up more, you can take a look for which tag has long message.

> Interesting enough - When migrating the project it works. I had it in Gitlab and migrated to Gitea and that worked fine.

Maybe there is another bug, IIRC some users reported that "git repo migration" doesn't sync tags correctly (https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/34767), Just FYI, TBH I don't know whether that issue is really a bug (tags don't get sync), or something unrelated.

> Thank you for the feedback! But this message isn't the one that causes the bug ... 😄

I just realised that as well :D

I sorted all commit messages by tag and length and the one bellow is the longest. There are 11 messages longer than 255 chars.

H5Part-1.6.5: added documentation for file open flags; added flags to h5pt_openr_par_align(); added H5PartSetViewEmpty() and h5pt_setview_empty() calls for creating empty hyperslab selections (previously kludge was to use H5PartSetViewIndices with a null list); fixed memory leak with file open flags in the Fortran interface; fixed missing statement in 1.6.x logic for _H5Part_have_group()

Which approach do you think is better?
1.	Truncate the title content to 255 characters
2.	Modify the column definition to allow a longer length
Introduce a util function to help to split the message title and body
